environment.description: Go microservice deployed on AWS Lambda with a Function URL. The function URL is configured with AuthType=AWS_IAM. Access requires valid SigV4 signatures from principals that have lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl permission. The resource policy on the function does NOT include a wildcard principal — it specifies only arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/InternalDashboardRole. Unauthenticated HTTP requests (missing or invalid Authorization header) receive an immediate 403 Forbidden from the Lambda service layer before the function code executes. Note: the function code itself has no authentication middleware — the IAM auth enforcement happens at the Lambda Function URL invoke layer, meaning the stored XSS payload could theoretically be inserted if a caller obtains valid credentials, but external attackers cannot reach either endpoint without SigV4 credentials bound to the specific IAM role.
